feeds.title: Cross Country Ski Areas Association
feeds.description: CCSAA is a complete resource for everything cross country ski related. On the pages of this website you will find information on getting started, learning more about the Nordic sports, finding a ski area, finding a retailer, and more.

feeds.title: UAA Nordic Ski Team
feeds.description: This is a place where friends of the UAA Ski Team can check in on the cross-country skiers as they train and race for the University of Alaska, Anchorage.

feeds.title: Canadian Birkebeiner Society ​
feeds.description: The Canadian Birkie Blog to learn more about what goes in to organizing a cross-country ski festival. A festival of classic style recreational and competitive cross country ski events organized by volunteers.

feeds.title: Kikkan Randall Blog
feeds.description: A blog by Kikkan Randall. Kikkan Randall is a 5-Time Olympian, Olympic & World Champion, 'Get-Activist' and Active Mom.

feeds.title: High Park Ski Club Blog » Cross-Country Skiing & Snowshoeing
feeds.description: High Park Ski Club is Toronto's longest established adult ski and snowboard club. And with age comes experience and knowing what makes for a successful winter sports club: exciting trips, professionally organized, fun people, varied activities and value for money second to none. Read about all of the latest news and events on Cross-Country Skiing & Snowshoeing at HPSC.

feeds.title: xcskiresorts.com Blog
feeds.description: Read the expert tips and news for your cross country ski and snowshoe vacations in North America.

feeds.title: FasterSkier
feeds.description: We offer high quality training articles and other information by knowledgeable experts for ambitious skiers and coaches. Sometimes just the basics, other times it will be something cutting-edge or controversial. We are all cross-country skiers, but within the sport there are a lot of specific interests: World Cup races, ski adventures, training plans, rollerskiing, local races, etc. We cover all aspects of the sport because we know our readers are interested in all aspects of the sport.

feeds.title: MNXC
feeds.description: Covers videos, how-to guides, ski trip ideas, equipment reviews, training plans, Birkie info, wax tips, and other useful information for Nordic skiers and snowshoers. MNXC is a cross country skiing blog written by Justin Eberhardt.
